en_title: CD Projekt's Cyberpunk 2077 Loremaster Confirms Year Edgerunners 2 Is Set, Sparking Fan Speculation About Canon Endings
cn_title: 《赛博朋克2077》《边缘行者2》故事定于2078年
subtitle: 时间不会停下
opus_summary: CDPR设定负责人Patrick Mills确认，《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》故事发生于2078年，也就是《赛博朋克2077》事件一年后。此消息引发粉丝对游戏正史结局的讨论，但动画并未迫使CDPR确定哪些结局属于正史。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt Red loremaster Patrick Mills has revealed the exact year Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 takes place, amid speculation from fans about what it means for the ending of Cyberpunk 2077.
paragraphs.cn: CDPR设定负责人Patrick Mills公布了《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》的故事发生年份。粉丝正在猜测，这一设定对《赛博朋克2077》的结局意味着什么。

paragraphs.en: According to Mills, Season 2 takes place not long after you bite the bullet and finally meet Hanako at Embers in Cyberpunk 2077.
paragraphs.cn: Mills表示，《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》的故事发生在玩家终于下定决心、前往余烬酒吧与Hanako会面之后不久。

paragraphs.en: "Ok so the thing is that I am seeing a lot of people assuming S2 takes place before 2077 but it doesn't, it takes place in 2078," Mills confirmed in a post on Bluesky . "Moving things forward, time doesn't stop in Cyberpunk."
paragraphs.cn: Mills在Bluesky上发文确认：「我看到很多人以为第二季的故事发生在《赛博朋克2077》之前，但事实并非如此。故事发生在2078年。」他还说：「故事继续向前推进，《赛博朋克》的时间不会停下。」

paragraphs.en: Mills previously posted about a misunderstanding he had seen in early reviews of the series, but wanted to wait until it was out before dropping a truth nuke.
paragraphs.cn: Mills此前曾发文谈到，他在该系列早期评论中看到了一处误解。不过，他想等作品正式推出后再揭晓这个重磅事实。

paragraphs.en: In Edgerunners Season 2, powerful corporation Arasaka doesn’t quite have the same pull it did during the events of Cyberpunk 2077 , which is a hint that the anime takes place after the events of the game. There are also some other smaller and bigger details, but like the loremaster, I don’t want to spoil things for you.
paragraphs.cn: 在《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》中，强大的荒坂公司已不像《赛博朋克2077》事件期间那样有影响力，这暗示动画故事发生在游戏事件之后。此外还有一些细节，既有小线索，也有重要信息，但和这位设定负责人一样，我不想剧透。

paragraphs.en: Now they know Edgerunners 2 is set just a year after the events of Cyberpunk 2077, fans are trying to work out what it means for the plot of the game . Some believe it suggests certain endings are canon. Or, perhaps it would be better to say, some believe it suggests certain endings are not canon. In truth, Edgerunners 2 doesn't force CD Projekt into making a decision about canon — a bit like Bethesda's position on Fallout canon in the context of the Amazon TV show, which takes place after all the video games.
paragraphs.cn: 得知《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》的故事发生在《赛博朋克2077》事件一年后，粉丝开始琢磨这一设定对游戏剧情意味着什么。有人认为，这说明某些结局属于正史；更准确地说，也有人认为它暗示某些结局并非正史。实际上，《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》并没有迫使CDPR决定哪些结局才是正史。这有点像贝塞斯达面对《辐射》正史问题时的态度：亚马逊剧集的故事发生在所有游戏之后。

paragraphs.en: The world of Cyberpunk is set to expand further, of course, with the in-development Cyberpunk 2 (where and when the game takes place is yet to be announced). There's also a live-action film in the works, although according to CD Projekt, the Cyberpunk 2077 movie won't retrace the game's steps .
paragraphs.cn: 《赛博朋克》的世界还将继续扩展。《赛博朋克2》目前正在开发中，但游戏的故事发生地点和时间尚未公布。真人电影也在制作中，不过CD Projekt表示，《赛博朋克2077》电影不会重走游戏的故事路线。

paragraphs.en: Before all that, Cyberpunk 2077 is set for a surprise Edgerunners 2-themed update this week. CD Projekt has confirmed it features cyberware customization and a new dual-wielding playstyle. CDPR released a similar update to tie into the first season. The Cyberpunk 2077 Edgerunners update added a short questline that let players track down the cool yellow jacket the protagonist of Season 1 wore. There’s a good chance the new update will come with some similar surprises when it drops on October 22.
paragraphs.cn: 在此之前，《赛博朋克2077》本周将推出一项惊喜更新，主题围绕《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》展开。CD Projekt确认，更新将加入义体自定义功能和双持玩法。为配合第一季，CDPR此前也推出过类似更新，其中包含一段短任务线，让玩家寻找第一季主角穿过的黄色夹克。新更新很可能也会带来类似惊喜，并于10月22日推出。

paragraphs.en: More details about the Edgerunners 2 update will be revealed today, October 21, 2026, during a special episode of REDstreams.
paragraphs.cn: 《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》主题更新的更多详情将于今天，也就是2026年10月21日，在REDstreams特别节目中公布。
